title: Sales Representative locks once invoiced and unlocks on reversal
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit.
  2. A test customer exists. If not: Customers -> New Customer, enter a name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and save.
  3. Two staff members are marked as sales representatives: Settings -> Staff -> open the staff member -> Edit Staff Member -> turn on the Sales Rep toggle -> save. Do this for two people (e.g. "Dana Lee" and "Sam Ortiz").
  4. A third staff member has the Sales Rep toggle off.
  5. A test vendor exists to order parts from. If not: Parts -> Vendors -> New Vendor, enter a Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Parts Supply"), then Save & Close.
  6. Start a new part sale today (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way): Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, then select the customer.
  7. In the header card set Sales Representative to the first rep (e.g. "Dana Lee").
  8. On the Parts tab click Add Part: Description "Brake Pads", Quantity 1, Vendor = the test vendor, Sell Price $290.91. Save the row.
  9. Order and Receive that part (Actions column: Order, then Receive and confirm). Receiving every part takes the sale to Complete.
  10. Click Create Invoice. In New Customer Payment record a payment for the full balance (Payment Method e.g. "Cash") and save. Do not just close the dialog: closing it without paying cancels the invoice.
  11. Then, on the Finance tab, find that payment in the payment history and reverse it. The sale stays invoiced, with no payment applied.
custom_steps:
1. On the invoiced sale, try to change the Sales Representative field and read the captured attribution.
  2. Reverse the invoice (the Reverse invoice action) and try the Sales Representative field again; change it to the second rep (e.g. "Sam Ortiz").
  3. Click Create Invoice again and read the Sales Representative the new invoice captured.
  4. On an open sale, open the Sales Representative picker and look for the non-rep staff member.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On the invoiced sale the Sales Representative field is read-only and the attribution captured at invoicing does not change.
  • After reversing the invoice the field can be edited again (e.g. changed to "Sam Ortiz").
  • The next invoice captures the representative afresh (e.g. "Sam Ortiz", not "Dana Lee").
  • A staff member not marked as a sales representative does not appear in the picker and cannot be selected.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10266 (Attribute a part sale to a sales representative); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 5; design canvas boards S5_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N3: “Once the sale is invoiced or paid the field is read-only, and the attribution captured at invoicing does not change afterwards”
  • S5-N3: “Reversing the invoice unlocks the field again, as on a work order”
  • S5-N3: “the next invoice captures the representative afresh”
  • S5-N4: “A staff member who is not marked as a sales representative cannot be selected”
